name: cloud-ios-roundtrip-eval-shim
_comment: READINESS SHIM for the SDD round-trip eval only. This branch's sdd-execute readiness (shared/sdd/readiness.ts) hardcodes a node gate profile (package.json + type-check/test/lint/...) and ignores gennady.yaml stack.anystack.extraGates, so a Swift/iOS repo can never reach EXECUTION_READY. The adaptive stack-plugin verify lives on `main`, unmerged into this flow branch (see ai/flow-eval/docs/journal/flow-verification-ledger.md, finding A7). These scripts satisfy the static readiness contract and exit 0; the REAL verification of the regenerated guard is the independent 82-probe behavioural bench in roundtrip-grade.sh, not these node gates. Remove once the flow branch consumes anystack readiness.

scripts.fix: npm run format:fix && npm run lint:fix
